Name: Farm Combat Grants XP Too
Author: atravita
Description:
[s][/s]This mod is mostly deprecated. In 1.6, monsters now award 1/3 of xp if killed on farm, and quests have a new field that can allow monsters on farm to count.[s] [/s]
[s]
In vanilla, when you kill a monster on the farm, you get no XP from it; nor does it count towards quests. This mod makes it so you do.[/s]

[b]NOTE: THE XP NUMBERS ARE FROM [url=https://github.com/Annosz/UIInfoSuite2/releases]UI INFO SUITE 2[/url]. THIS MOD DOES NOT ADD XP NUMBERS, IT JUST RESTORES THE ABILITY TO GET XP ON THE FARM.[/b]

[size=4]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4]Config options[/size]
Run SMAPI at least once with this mod installed to generate the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font], or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure.

[list]
[*][font=Courier New]GainExp[/font] restores full XP gain from monster kills on farm.
[*][font=Courier New]QuestCompletion[/font] counts monster kills on farm towards billboard quest completion.
[*][font=Courier New]SpecialOrderCompletion[/font] counts monster kills on farm towards special order objectives.
[/list]
[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. Can probably be installed by just one player in multiplayer.
[/list]

[size=5]See also[/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/ExpFromMonsterKillsOnFarm/ExpFromMonsterKillsOnFarm/docs/CHANGELOG.MD]Release notes[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/ExpFromMonsterKillsOnFarm/ExpFromMonsterKillsOnFarm]Source code[/url]
[/list]

Requires SMAPI, uses Harmony.

All donation points for this mod go to [url=https://www.againstmalaria.com/]Against Malaria[/url]. Please consider supporting them if you like this mod!
Looking for something else? Please consider [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/116553368?tab=user+files]my other mods[/url]!
